scenes.text: This guide is for voters. You open the voting link you were given.

scenes.title: Sign in, if asked
scenes.text: If the poll asks for an account, you sign in or create one. Some polls let anyone with the link vote straight away.

scenes.title: Choose and vote
scenes.text: Choose one candidate for each position and press Vote. Your vote is secret.

scenes.title: Done
scenes.text: You are thanked straight away, and if the organizer allows it, you can watch the live results.
